objective: Run the frozen fully label-free v0.72 compiler, selector and exact planners on the seven genuinely fresh v0.74 hash-locked UCI datasets with independent Rust replay.

adapter_protocol.metadata: official per-dataset UCI JSON must match the v0.74 canonical metadata digest
adapter_protocol.data: standardized CSV byte length and SHA-256 must match the v0.74 lock
adapter_protocol.feature_columns: metadata variables whose role is exactly Feature, in metadata order
adapter_protocol.target_column: the single metadata Target variable, exactly matching the v0.74 target column
adapter_protocol.ignored_columns: metadata ID and Other variables are excluded
adapter_protocol.csv: UTF-8-sig with csv.DictReader; unique headers must contain every frozen feature and target column
adapter_protocol.values: strip whitespace; absent cells become the empty token; labels must be nonempty
adapter_protocol.shape: record and feature counts must exactly equal the v0.74 metadata lock

claim_boundary: A pass is repository-audited fresh external evidence for the frozen Mini-ORIGIN v0.72 method. It is not outside-human reproduction, peer review, publication novelty, acceptance, a general AI breakthrough, or a world-level/world-first claim.
